import csv
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile

archives = [("animals", sys.argv[1]), ("fungi", sys.argv[2])]
rows = []
for group, archive_path in archives:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        members = sorted(
            n for n in archive.namelist()
            if not n.endswith("/") and n.endswith(".faa.mafft")
        )
        if not members:
            raise RuntimeError(f"No .faa.mafft members found in {group} archive")
        for member in members:
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
                alignment_path = os.path.join(tmp, "alignment.faa")
                with archive.open(member) as source, open(alignment_path, "wb") as target:
                    target.write(source.read())
                result = subprocess.run(
                    ["phykit", "parsimony_informative_sites", alignment_path],
                    check=True,
                    text=True,
                    capture_output=True,
                )
                fields = result.stdout.strip().split("\t")
                if len(fields) != 3:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected PhyKIT output for {member}: {result.stdout!r}")
                rows.append((group, member, int(fields[0]), int(fields[1]), float(fields[2])))

with open("pis_counts.tsv", "w", newline="") as handle:
    writer = csv.writer(handle, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(["group", "alignment", "raw_parsimony_informative_sites", "alignment_length", "percent_parsimony_informative_sites"])
    writer.writerows(rows)
PY
